name: Blueberry Pie Dessert Bars

instructions.primary_message: For the Shortbread Crust: Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Lightly coat a 13- x 23-cm metal baking pan with cooking spray. Line bottom and sides of pan with two long strips of parchment to cover the bottom and sides, leaving a 5-cm overhang on long ends, and creasing as needed to ensure a secure fit. Lightly coat parchment with cooking spray.

In a large bowl, whisk together flour, brown sugar, granulated sugar, and salt until combined. Stir in melted butter until evenly combined and small pea-sized clumps form. Transfer 2 1/2 cups crumb mixture to a small bowl; refrigerate until ready to use for crumb topping. Press remaining 3 1/2 cups crumb mixture in an even layer in bottom of prepared pan.
Bake crust until set in center and beginning to brown around edges, 18 to 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool completely, about 15 minutes.

For the Blueberry Filling: In a large saucepan, combine blueberries, sugar, cornstarch, lemon zest and juice, ground cinnamon, and coriander and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring often and gently mashing some of the berries with a fork or potato masher, until mixture is thickened, bubbly, and bottom of saucepan is visible when stirred, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and whisk in lemon juice and cool slightly, about 30 minutes.

Once cooled, spread blueberry filling evenly over shortbread crust. Sprinkle reserved crumb mixture evenly over filling, crumbling like a streusel as you go. Bake, rotating pan halfway through, until topping is golden brown and filling is bubbling around the edges, 45 to 55 minutes. Cool completely in pan on a wire rack, about 2 hours. Using parchment overhang as handles, lift bars from pan and transfer to a cutting board. Cut into squares and serve.

description: These easy blueberry pie bars pair a thick, jammy fresh blueberry filling with a buttery shortbread crust and crumbly streusel topping.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 6 hr 15 min.

Make-ahead and storage: Wrapped tightly in plastic, the bars will keep up to 4 days at cool room temperature.
author: Leah Colins
